decisions: Agreed with Josh 2 Nov: Tue moves to the 5:30pm class; Fri is rest (not training); Sun is optional.

POLP deloads for deadlift, press and back squat (done 3 weeks running, per Jason's note). Bench was missed last week, so it continues at 94 × 3 × 10. Don't log the deload sessions in the workbook; next week picks up at the next blank row.
Row W1 S1 goes straight after Wed AM WL (5:30–7:15 double). WL is light this week, so the legs are fine for it. Tuesday's 3200m row race stays as written (Josh).
Tuesday's HSPU OTM (max deficit + strict HSPU) is this week's HSPU session, replacing the Sunday EMOM. Leave 1–2 reps in the tank and note your best strict set as a baseline.
Thursday as written, tricep work included (Josh). Bench is first in the comp class.
Saturday is WL only: the partner WOD has 2 miles of running (parked until after the comp). The pause front squat at 112 is the set to protect.
Front squat extra = Wednesday PM's Bulgarian split squats kept light, plus Spanish squat holds if you have a band.
Mon class comes before WL, so 60–70% (Jason's note). Do the strict ring muscle-ups on M4.
Endurance track skipped (bike, pyramid cycle, run, class Row W8). You're on Row W1.

streams.text:
5 x 300m, rest 1 min between. 70%, 75%, 80%, 85%, 90% efforts respectively.
+
4 Sets;

*+2 seconds means +2 seconds slower than your set pace.

streams.label: Optional — Row W1 S2 + ring MU drills
